card.name: Partway into hypocalcemia and calcium words
card.fires_on: Pieces of words just before the 'cal' in calcium-type terms, mainly 'hyp' or 'hypocal' in hypocalcemia. It also fires on a hyphen before calcium and on 'cal' in 'calculated'.

modes.label: Hypocalcemia spelling
modes.description: The pieces 'hyp' or 'ocal' inside the word hypocalcemia, where 'cemia' comes next.
modes.example: Hyperphosphatemia can lead to<< hyp>>ocalcemia, which may be severe

modes.label: Calcium compound or calculation
modes.description: A hyphen or 'cal' just before 'calcium' or 'calculated'.
modes.example: Precipitation of ceftriaxone<<-c>>alcium can also occur when Cef

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'cal' pieces, as in calcium or calculate.
card.plain: It lights up while a word is being spelled out toward calcium, especially low calcium (hypocalcemia).
